command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
echo '@@ HASH_START'
sha256sum /usr/lib/libhdmi-control.so.0.1
echo '@@ DATA'
dd if=/usr/lib/libhdmi-control.so.0.1 bs=32768 skip=1 count=1 2>/dev/null | base64
echo '@@ HASH_END'
sha256sum /usr/lib/libhdmi-control.so.0.1
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
purpose: Finite fixed-module passive copy; no load/callback/getter/control/trace; no retry; physical panel unobserved.
